title: 送丝机、焊丝与喷嘴
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/194_送丝机、焊丝与喷嘴.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/194_送丝机、焊丝与喷嘴/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在送丝机旁，手里拿着一盘焊丝和一个导嘴
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wire feeder holding a spool of filler wire and a small wire guide nozzle, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第三十二课：送丝机、焊丝与喷嘴。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一盘粗焊丝要直接装上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student grabs a spool of thicker filler wire and hurries toward an open wire feeder.
shots.narration: 阿杰：换粗丝？直接装上去！

shots.scene: 焊丝在送丝管里打弯卡住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick wire jammed and kinked inside a small wire guide and feed rollers, a red cross icon. No text.
shots.narration: 轮和导嘴没换，丝卡住了。

shots.scene: 老李拿着说明书和对照表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds an open manual with a size matching chart and points to the feed rollers.
shots.narration: 老李：先断电，轮、导嘴跟着换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a handheld laser welder and a wire feeder switched off and unplugged, the screen dark. No text.
shots.narration: 安装接线、换轮换嘴，先关机断电。

shots.scene: 通电送丝，出光使能关闭
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feed button pressed while a laser enable icon is switched off and crossed laser rays. No text.
shots.narration: 通电送丝时，不开出光使能。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sharp wire tip with a warning icon, a welding torch pointed at a person crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 丝尖锋利，焊嘴不能对着人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire feeder linked to a welding icon with a check, cleaning and cutting icons without the feeder. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝机只在焊接时用，清洗切割不用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: top view of a laser welder main unit with a wire feeder placed on its left side. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝机放在主机左侧。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a foot pressing down the brake on each of four casters of a wire feeder.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮都踩下锁住。

shots.scene: 电缆两头一样，凸起朝上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round connection cable with identical ends, a small key bump on the plug aligned upward with the socket. No text.
shots.narration: 连接电缆两头一样，凸起朝上插。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers turning the metal locking ring of a round connector until tight.
shots.narration: 插到位，再拧紧金属外圈。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a feed roller with a size mark on its side matched with a wire spool label. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝轮外侧标着规格，要和焊丝一致。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电，打开驱动，拆螺丝装轮
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands opening the feed drive of a powered off wire feeder, removing a screw and fitting a feed roller.
shots.narration: 打开驱动，拆螺丝，装上对应的轮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spare pair of feed rollers stored in a holder above the drive inside the feeder. No text.
shots.narration: 另一对轮子收在上方备用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the right pressure arm closed and a side screw loosened inside the wire feeder. No text.
shots.narration: 先合上右压紧器，松开侧面螺丝。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire conduit with a plain end and a clip end, the plain end pushed into the feeder outlet. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝管不带卡扣的一端插进送丝机。

shots.scene: 顶到底拧紧，再打开压紧器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the conduit guide pushed fully home, the screw tightened, then the pressure arm opened. No text.
shots.narration: 顶到底拧紧，再打开压紧器。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spool cap unscrewed and a spool adapter sleeve removed from the spindle. No text.
shots.narration: 拧下盖子，取下套筒。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands sliding a wire spool onto the spindle with its hole aligned to the locating pin.
shots.narration: 丝盘的孔对准销钉装上。

shots.scene: 丝从盘底出来，大盘不装套筒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wire leaving from the bottom of the spool toward the rollers, a large spool fitted without the sleeve, the cap screwed back. No text.
shots.narration: 丝从盘下方出来，大盘不装套筒。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fingers pinching the wire end, a loose spool unwinding into a tangle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 取丝头一直捏紧，松手就会散开。

shots.scene: 【实拍】戴护目镜，钳子剪掉弯头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand cutting off the bent end of a filler wire with pliers, the user wearing safety glasses.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，用钳子剪掉弯头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the straight wire end pushed gently through the feed rollers into the conduit while held. No text.
shots.narration: 捏着丝轻推，穿过轮子进送丝管。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand keeping hold of the wire so it does not spring back onto the spool. No text.
shots.narration: 一直捏住，防止焊丝往回缩。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pressure arms closed down onto the wire between the rollers. No text.
shots.narration: 合上压紧器，压住焊丝。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers turning the pressure knob on a wire feeder pressure arm to a scale mark.
shots.narration: 转旋钮调送丝压力。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a manual table linking wire size to a pressure level, a magnifier on one row. No text.
shots.narration: 压力等级按说明书的表格选。

shots.scene: 按住送丝键，丝盘匀速转
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a finger holding the feed button on the feeder or screen, the spool turning steadily. No text.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，丝盘匀速转动。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire tip just out of the guide nozzle with a stop icon, a too long wire with a retract arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 丝一露头就松手，长了按回抽。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire feeder door closed and latched. No text.
shots.narration: 送完丝，关好送丝机门。

shots.scene: 【实拍】打开卡扣，送丝管卡到焊枪头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands opening a clip and sliding the wire conduit onto the front of a powered off welding torch, then closing it.
shots.narration: 打开卡扣，送丝管卡到焊枪头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the filler wire running in the groove of the welding nozzle, a wire off the groove crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊丝要从焊接嘴的槽里出来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: feed and retract buttons on the torch adjusting the wire length, the conduit strapped to the cable, the torch on its holder. No text.
shots.narration: 焊枪键微调丝长，固定好放回支架。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the clip end of the wire conduit with a small removable wire guide nozzle. No text.
shots.narration: 送丝管卡扣端，装着可换的导嘴。

shots.scene: 两种孔径，对应不同丝径
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two guide nozzles with different bore sizes, each linked to a pair of wire size icons. No text.
shots.narration: 导嘴有两种孔径，对应不同丝径。

shots.scene: 【实拍】拧下旧导嘴，换对应规格
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers unscrewing a guide nozzle from the conduit end and screwing on another one, a size chart nearby.
shots.narration: 看清丝径，查表换上对应导嘴。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire retracted into the conduit, then the wire feed enable switched off. No text.
shots.narration: 换导嘴前，先回抽焊丝、关送丝。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worn guide nozzle with an enlarged bore making the wire wobble off the red dot, a new nozzle with a check. No text.
shots.narration: 孔磨大了丝会晃，要及时换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crooked guide nozzle with laser hitting the copper and a reflection crossed out, a straight nozzle with the wire tip on the red dot. No text.
shots.narration: 装歪光会打到铜嘴反射，要装正。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin wire spool swapped for a thicker one, a feed roller and a guide nozzle icon with change arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 换粗一号的焊丝，配件要跟着换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the feeder door opened, the spool cap and sleeve removed, both pressure arms opened. No text.
shots.narration: 开门拧盖取套筒，打开两个压紧器。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the spool turned backward by hand, the wire withdrawn from the drive and conduit. No text.
shots.narration: 倒转丝盘，把丝从驱动里退出来。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers bending the wire end and tucking it into a small hole on the spool rim.
shots.narration: 丝头弯好插进盘边小孔，不散开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the screw removed and the current pair of feed rollers taken off. No text.
shots.narration: 拆螺丝，取下现在的送丝轮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the spare rollers taken from the upper holder, the size mark compared with the new wire label. No text.
shots.narration: 取出备用轮，核对规格和新丝一致。

shots.scene: 装新轮，旧轮存好，换导嘴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: new rollers fitted and screwed, the old pair stored above, a larger guide nozzle fitted. No text.
shots.narration: 装好新轮，旧轮存上方，导嘴也换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new spool mounted on the pin, the sleeve and cap fitted back. No text.
shots.narration: 装新丝盘，装回套筒，拧好盖子。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire end pinched, the bent tip cut off, the wire pressed gently through the rollers. No text.
shots.narration: 引丝剪弯头，轻压穿过送丝轮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pressure arms closed and the knob reset to a new level from the manual table. No text.
shots.narration: 换了丝径，压力按表格重新调。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the feed button held until the wire comes out of the guide nozzle. No text.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，送到丝伸出导嘴。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wire spools in original packaging on a dry shelf, a rusty wire and an unreadable label crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊丝干燥处原包装存，生锈不用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank settings screen with a wire size icon updated to match the new spool. No text.
shots.narration: 换了丝，屏幕上的丝径也要改。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trial weld on a scrap plate with laser safety glasses icon, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 参数改好，戴防护镜先在废料试。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the power switched off, the screen and indicator lights dark. No text.
shots.narration: 换焊接嘴，第一步关闭电源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hot welding nozzle with heat waves resting on the holder, a clock, heat resistant gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 刚用完很烫，等凉了戴手套再换。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wire conduit unclipped from the torch head and placed aside neatly. No text.
shots.narration: 清洗不用送丝，先拆下送丝管。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the welding nozzle unscrewed and placed into a nozzle storage box. No text.
shots.narration: 拆下焊接嘴，放进喷嘴盒。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cleaning nozzle inspected with a magnifier, deformed, burnt and blocked nozzles crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 装前看看，变形烧蚀堵塞的不用。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands screwing a cleaning nozzle onto the head of a powered off handheld laser torch until snug and straight.
shots.narration: 换上清洗嘴，拧紧到位不歪。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank screen with the cleaning mode icon selected to match the fitted nozzle, a mismatch crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开机先选对应模式，再开出光。

shots.scene: 剪下的丝头放进废料盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cut wire ends dropped into a metal scrap box, wire ends on the floor crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 剪下的丝头放进废料盒。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance log with a wire spool icon and a nozzle icon being ticked. No text.
shots.narration: 换了什么，写进使用维护记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power off icon, a feed roller and a guide nozzle matched with a wire spool. No text.
shots.narration: 断电安装，轮和导嘴都对丝径。

shots.scene: 方向对、丝头捏紧、按表调压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: spool direction arrow, a pinched wire end and a pressure table icon. No text.
shots.narration: 丝盘方向对，丝头捏紧，按表调压。

shots.scene: 换嘴先断电冷却，模式对应
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooled nozzle, a nozzle box and a matching mode icon. No text.
shots.narration: 换嘴断电冷却，嘴和模式对应。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一片保护镜片和无尘布
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small protective lens and a lint free wipe, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：镜片、校准与日常维护。
